csv_project_name: Engineering for Detour State Harbor Fuel Tanks Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Michigan Department of Natural Resources (MDNR) Parks and Recreation Division (PRD), the Department of Technology, Management, and Budget (DTMB) is seeking a Professional Services Consultant (PSC) requesting professional engineering services for the assessment of two aged underground fuel tanks that are at the extent of their useful lifespan. Additionally, the fuel lines from the tanks to the docks, spill buckets/sumps, fuel pumps, and cathodic protection shall also be reviewed. Considering existing configurations and conditions, the PSC shall recommend and design two new fuel tanks and associated fuel delivery equipment
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Underground Tank Design, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering
